description_en: Queries the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instances attached to a specified backend server
description_zh: 查询指定后端服务器绑定的全球加速实例
kebab_example: aliyun vpc describe-server-related-global-acceleration-instances --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --server-id i-12s3sdf0000 --server-type EcsInstance --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeServerRelatedGlobalAccelerationInstances

parameters.help_en:
The region where the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance resides. 

You can invoke https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html to obtain the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
全球加速实例所在的地域。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backend service instance
parameters.name: server_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the backend service instance. Valid values: 

- **EcsInstance** (default): ECS instance.

- **SlbInstance**: load balancing instance
parameters.help_zh:
后端服务实例的类型，取值： 

- **EcsInstance**（默认值）：ECS实例

- **SlbInstance**：负载均衡实例
parameters.name: server_type
